record.label: N1.5 GOAL-CLASS candidate: the ~35 missing variance points — higher-order carried content or the consumption's form
record.summary: Exact third-order carry in the dense engine with EVERY input made exact still cuts only 7.5-10.6% (all-oracle arm, r35, F2J-on frame); truth v alone would cut 47%, truth v+k3+k4 73.5% (7.09e-9 < 1e-8). So the third-order carry route caps at a 10-15% rung. The remaining points are content the third-order carrier lacks (fourth-order distinct entries) and/or the linearized consumption (S∘dK21 -> dC_post). Deciding rows (teammate B, running): truth pre-planes through the tangent (ceiling of any plane supply through the current consumption); truth-post-plane wedge; gate-only and card-plane ablations. Derived candidates on record: SOL's H4 reverse-adjoint theorem (exact endpoint accumulation of H4 square births, O(n^2) state, O(Ln^3) work; graph P2R0G19B_MATH_H4_REVERSE_RANK and children, open mathematics) and the second-order pair Edgeworth consumer (phase-1 E1A1). T-20 part 2: no input's exactness raises dv fidelity; the binding element is the carried content's multi-push fidelity plus the linearized consumer. Teammate A is testing the second-order pair consumer with truth planes; teammate D is assessing the derived quantities as operator features (refit on MPS if positive). Matt: [instruction removed]). CLOSED (T-32/T-36): the '12 v / 20 joint missing points' were same-sample noise; a consumer beyond the linearization recovers <= +0.6 (21.0/21.0/21.6 K21; 36.0/36.1/36.7 all planes; honest 24.4 vs 23.1). The goal-class levers are N2 (per-unit k3, 30 honest), N1.2 (planes/carry, 24.4 honest ceiling) and N1.3 (off-diagonal covariance, 19.4 honest); joint honest oracle 49.9 -> ~1.47e-8 = Matt's bank line.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when a priced mechanism accounts for >= 30 of the 47 variance points on r35 and r100 with a deployable form.
record.goal_path_summary: Even a perfect version of the third-order fix is only a sixth of the way; the rest of the variance error needs either the next order of statistics or a better way of consuming them - the running measurements say which.
